name: Face-cam + Overlay
description: Talking-head tutorials: your clip on a rounded face sheet at the bottom, a bordered overlay card with a section chip above it, hard cuts with a face punch-in about every 2 s, bold centred captions with one serif-italic keyword.
rules: The face never leaves the frame for more than about 3 s.
One card, one idea, section colour on the border and the chip (PRD orange, design purple, build black).
Hard cuts only; alternate wide and punch-in crops of the face.
Captions: 1 to 3 words, white heavy sans over the face, black over cream, one keyword in serif italic caps.
native_moves: card grows to fill the frame for one beat, then the face returns
a face punch-in on the keyword

structures: numbered steps with a card each
one claim, three screenshots, a CTA
before and after of one document
endings: the face with the last card pinned above

camera_language: Face crops punch in and out on hard cuts; the card animates in place.
typography: word-pop captions with an accent keyword.
audio_direction: Voice from the clip; music bed 6 dB under, no sound effects.
pitfalls: Do not put captions over the face's mouth.
Do not hide the face for long stretches.
